predecessors.name: Granadine Confederation
predecessors.text: the whole Granadine Confederation, renamed by the Rionegro Constitution

successors.name: Republic of Colombia
successors.text: the same territory, under the unitary and centralist constitution of 1886

ledger.x: 8 May 1863: the Rionegro Constitution makes the Granadine Confederation the United States of Colombia.
1886: Núñez's constitution abolishes the United States of Colombia.

certainty.note: The page gives no boundary treaty; the Amazon frontiers with Peru, Brazil and Ecuador were claims, and the Panama–Costa Rica line was not fixed.
